decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on maximizing the potential of aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. It includes powerful cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Guide of Souls, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, along with removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. Arena of Glory provides additional combat tricks, while Ocelot Pride boosts creature power. The deck also includes some control elements with Static Prison and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Overall, the key strategy involves building a strong board presence and dealing direct damage to control the pace of the game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. By utilizing cards that can trigger abilities whenever spells are cast, like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, and having a high number of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and end the game quickly. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain to smooth out draws and maximize efficiency in order to maintain pressure throughout the match.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the battlefield to secure a swift victory. The deck also features some utility cards like Static Prison and Elegant Parlor to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own game plan.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Mutagenic Growth, and Lava Dart, as well as creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and keep up the tempo throughout the game. Additionally, card selection and advantage are important with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to ensure the deck consistently has the tools needed to maintain its aggressive strategy.

The deck is centered around utilizing the synergies between lands and ramp spells to quickly build up mana and power out key combo pieces like Primeval Titan. The goal is to ramp up to a critical mass of lands, allowing for explosive plays like resolving a Scapeshift or Amulet of Vigor to tutor for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus while utilizing utility lands like Urza's Saga to generate additional value.

This deck focuses on using Broodscale Bloodchief's ability to manipulate +1/+1 counters on creatures to create a powerful combo. The key strategy involves using cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble to generate counters, while also utilizing Ancient Stirrings to find the necessary pieces. Walking Ballista and Glaring Fleshraker serve as key creatures in the combo, with support from cards like Kozilek's Command and Springleaf Drum. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a lethal army of creatures.

This deck focuses on countering and removing threats while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and control elements. It utilizes powerful cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, and Fatal Push to control the board and protect its win conditions like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The inclusion of Sauron's Ransom and Psychic Frog offer additional control options, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure smooth casting of spells throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Hollow One and Marauding Mako, while utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Goblin Lore to quickly discard cards and enable bigger plays. Detective's Phoenix helps to maintain board presence and provide additional threats. Lightning Bolt and Tarfire provide targeted removal, while Nethergoyf and Orcish Bowmasters offer versatility in dealing with various threats. Arena of Glory can give the deck an advantage in combat situations. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient use of resources.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Flooded Strand for additional damage and control. The deck focuses on both creature power and burn spells to quickly bring the opponent's life total down, with cards like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury providing additional support. Additionally, cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls help to pump up the team and push for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with the ability to repeatedly blink key creatures for added value. Utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to trigger powerful enters-the-battlefield effects, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By combining aggressive creature cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd with powerful blink effects, the deck can maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Relic of Progenitus also helps to control graveyard strategies, further solidifying the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently by playing low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, while supporting them with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The deck also utilizes cantrips such as Preordain and Mishra's Bauble to dig for more threats and keep the pressure on the opponent. By combining aggressive creatures with direct damage spells and card draw, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressively blinking creatures in and out of play to generate value and disrupt opponents. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Aether Vial, the deck aims to constantly flicker creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to control the board and generate advantage. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and disruptive creatures like Skyclave Apparition, the deck looks to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive flicker strategy while maintaining control of the battlefield.

Utilizing Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to establish control over the game, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while disrupting their game plan with removal and counterspells. By ramping into Eldrazi titans like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, the deck can quickly close out games while also having access to powerful utility creatures like Sire of Seven Deaths and Nulldrifter. The deck's mana base is designed to support the Eldrazi theme with Eldrazi Temple and Ugin's Labyrinth, ensuring a smooth mana curve for the powerful spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to effectively use Goblin Charbelcher as a win condition. By utilizing cards that allow for alternate casting costs like Disrupting Shoal and Fallaji Archaeologist, as well as tutoring for key pieces with Whir of Invention, the deck aims to efficiently ramp up mana with Lotus Bloom and generate card advantage with Sea Gate Restoration. Additionally, the deck includes disruption elements like Thundertrap Trainer and Suppression Ray to control the board and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive Eldrazi creatures and using disruptive spells like Kozilek's Command and Chalice of the Void to control the game. The deck also includes powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths to apply pressure on the opponent. The mana base is optimized to cast Eldrazi spells efficiently, with cards like Eldrazi Temple and Unclaimed Territory. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful Eldrazi creatures, while disrupting their game plan with spells and abilities.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while using cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt their game plan. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride provide additional support for your creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury offer powerful finishers. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Thraben Charm for removal and tricks. Overall, this deck aims to quickly establish board presence and close out the game before the opponent can recover.
